how_to_use: Copy profile, keep the sections that matter to you, leave unknowns null. Pass it as usair_home_check(profile=...).

fields.state: Two-letter code; used for the SIP lookup.
fields.topics: Any of outdoor_burning, idling, wood_heating, paint_solvent, spray_coating. Left out: taken from the sections you fill in.
fields.burning.what: yard_waste, leaves, brush, trash, plastic, tires, treated_wood, pallets, commercial_waste, ...
fields.wood_heater.kind: wood_stove, pellet_stove, fireplace, masonry_heater, hydronic_heater (outdoor wood boiler), forced_air_furnace.
fields.wood_heater.buying_new: true if you are buying or installing a new unit.
fields.wood_heater.manufacture_date: From the label, YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD.
fields.wood_heater.epa_certified: true if the label shows an EPA certificate.
fields.coatings.spray_applies: true if you spray paint or other coatings (not brush/roller).
fields.coatings.vehicles_per_year: How many motor vehicles or pieces of mobile equipment you spray-coat per year.
fields.coatings.for_compensation: true if you are paid for the work.
fields.coatings.target_hap: true if the coatings contain chromium, lead, manganese, nickel or cadmium (see the SDS).
fields.coatings.paint_stripping_methylene_chlor: true if you use a methylene chloride paint stripper.
fields.makes_or_imports_coatings: true if your business makes, imports or private-labels paints, solvents or spray cans.
